India Built An Empire. Pakistan Built Excuses.

While India built structure, discipline, and a cricket industry through the IPL and a strong domestic system, Pakistan cricket kept reacting — to pressure, to politics, and to the obsession of beating India.

From the Parchi debate… to boycott drama during the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup 2026… from PSL vs IPL economics… to PCB instability under Mohsin Naqvi — this video breaks down the real structural gap between India and Pakistan cricket.

This is not about emotion.
This is about systems.
